searchText: Geth help please.. trying to free up space on my SSD using this command `sudo -u goeth geth removedb --datadir /var/lib/goethereum --datadir.ancient /mnt/geth/ancient` but the result is error **flag provided but not defined: -datadir.ancient** 1. Any docs on this please 2. Should I run it without the --datadir.ancient flag? Hi, where can I ask devp2p related questions? 1. How does Geth replies to a `GetBlockBodies (0x05)` request, for example, If I'm doing request for 16 Block Bodies using their hashes, but only 15 of them are available. What would reply Geth and would it reply at all? AFAIK it will return the available blocks. thanks

excerpts.content:
